## Deploy readiness board (R100, informational)

This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.

```

    --- STUB VALUES [RED=0] ---
```

FIX ROUND 0 (B-RECUR5A-117, agent 117) — growth-project-backend#701 @ 69afde257226ba9bf200432707fe9b536f9479bc

Opened as tests-only split R5 for #679's fix round 5 ([5977577322](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/679#issuecomment-5977577322)): `test/b-recur5a-117-moved-fix-round-4.spec.ts` is byte-for-byte `test/b-recur2-116-fix-round-4.spec.ts` as of #679 f48fa8f0 (sha256 `0d33b62cb5f73a05cbc22a80fdfed02d2c8973e5daa756e086dd3b45650bfa15` for both). #679 removes the old path in `436f9d1c`. The new path is on purpose: a restack merge that brings that removal up the stack keeps a file only this piece added (a renamed copy at the old path would be deleted by the merge).

| Item | Evidence |
|---|---|
| contents unchanged | `sha256sum` equal (above); no other file in the diff |
| passes on this base | local targeted jest 18/18 |
| passes on #679 436f9d1c (round-5 fixes) | local targeted jest 18/18 |

Until B-RECUR5B-117 restacks #680 and #696 onto #679 `436f9d1c`, this base still has the old path, so the same 18 cases run twice (harmless). After that restack this PR merges #696 (merge-only).

Required checks at this head: all green, no reruns: build-and-test ([run 37184408586](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37184408586)), community/mwb-3/rls live tests, rls-floor-guard, schema parity, npm audit, size-label, test/comment-deploy-readiness pass (10 pass); deploy-readiness-gate skipping (not required).

READY FOR AUDIT
